name: Endou Akira
source:
Akira lives in Nagasaki (長崎), Nagasaki and goes to Seirin Girls High School (誠林女子高校) where she is a third year student in class C.

She likes to play the violin, and her favorite subjects in school are music and world history. She likes to collect hairbands, ear rings, and other accessories. She also likes to play tennis and go shopping.

Her voice is done by Suzuki Urarako (鈴木麗子).
